notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Shifting Wall.
description:
Sacrifice Shifting Wall to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Endless One for {1}.
Sacrifice Endless One to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shifting Wall for {1}.
Repeat.
